phase_prompt.summary: Standard operational appearance as an archive keeper.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body shot of Lebit'sumu, a mystical industrial archivist in a dimly lit ancient tech corridor. Tall gaunt figure wearing heavy woven basalt robes and tarnished copper mesh. Face obscured by a translucent obsidian visor with faint glowing amber glyphs. Complex multi-lens optical sensors. Articulated metal hands with stylus fingers. Chest-mounted faint power core. Atmosphere of dust and sacred machinery. Cinematic lighting, photorealistic, octane render, 8k, tactile textures.
